title: Improve Milestone Input Contract
description: Required inputs for improve-milestone skill invocation - manages complex improvements with GSD-style phase cycles

plugin_name.description: Name of plugin to improve (must be Working or Installed status)

skip_phases.description: Phases to skip (plan and execute cannot be skipped)

force_version_bump.description: Override automatic version bump type detection
